These public headers and auxiliary library come from Lua 5.2.4 at
https://www.lua.org/ftp/lua-5.2.4.tar.gz.

The archive SHA-256 is `b9e2e4aad6789b3b63a056d442f7b39f0ecfca3ae0f1fc0ae4e9614401b69f4b`.
The files are unchanged upstream copies. The auxiliary library and standard-library registration file are
compiled. Oximond supplies the interpreter and standard libraries.
Lua's MIT license and copyright notice remain in `lua.h`.
